mde_definition: Normal-approximation difference in predictive MAE: (z_0.975 + z_0.8) × conditional bootstrap SE. Not the detectable biological lunar effect or validated prospective model power.
limitations: Sign test assumes independent participant signs under null. Shared calendar dates and shared fitted models create dependence not represented by this binomial calculation.
Sequential exploratory analyses and selection are not corrected; p-values are nominal descriptive calculations.
Bootstrap resamples fixed participant prediction errors, without model refitting or calendar dependence.
Approximate MDE assumes stable variance and normal approximation under alternatives; this does not establish actual 80% power.
Interpretation is no demonstrated predictive gain from tested geometric features on this cohort, not evidence that lunar biology is absent.
